Name: Simple Fruits
Author: PhobicPaul
Description:
This is just a small content pack for Stardew Valley. To use this mod, SMAPI and Content Patcher are required.
Simple Fruits content pack changes icons of apricot, cherry, orange, peach, apple, and pomegranate to simpler ones.

This is very simple content pack, because I'm just learning how to make mods.

Manifest.Name: Simple Fruits
Manifest.Description: Changes icons of 8 basic fruits to simpler ones, just for fun.
